agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was tried first and succeeded: the contracts, the action environment, the frame-based touch sets and the capability planner all already existed, so no planner, no world model and no policy were built. What did not exist was any notion of a fact that persists across steps and can be falsified; the tree only had replay staleness across runs. The smallest new object is a dict of (path, hash, established_at) plus an invalidation rule read off frames.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Independent personnel verification is still open.

expected_parent_change: A per-action check cannot see a correct step make an earlier proof false. On three real five-step chains with real programs, the sabotage step is legal and its own contract holds; every step passes a per-step check (3/3 chains claim success), while the independent goal command fails on 3/3 at the last step. A ledger of standing facts, re-validating only the facts the current step frame can touch, detects 3/3, localises the causal step 3/3, raises on 0 of 3 unsabotaged controls, and costs 3 hashes against 69 for re-hashing every fact after every step. explicit_user_authorization: Is instant learning a complete solution for all computer use and the most advanced software engineering? What is real and what is not?
What is the single bottleneck that, if fixed, unlocks the most capability?
Own weights from scratch, every parameter calculated, an instant knowledge source, and the best part is no part.

falsification_condition: Any detection credited without a control chain; any sabotage step that is not legal under its own contract (then the prior receipt would have caught it and this proves nothing); claiming repair, goal grounding, remote-state facts or any terminal credit.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The coding barrier is not candidate generation and not memory: it is that most real work has no sibling, so the capability has to be synthesis plus verification per instance, and memory is worth exactly the measured repeated minority.

obs_goal.real_outcome: The permanent object is the method (decision procedure + premise + cost) and the verifier, never the plan: a learned action may veto but never license, every application re-proves its premise on the live state and re-reads the result against the sentence it claims, and composition re-checks the second premise against the first step's effect instead of against the record.
obs_goal.surviving_necessity: Coding capability is gated on a correct candidate existing at all; no oracle, budget or weight can select a hypothesis the basis cannot build.

obs_inherited_system.adjacent_capabilities_absorbed: None by claim: the existing repair primitive and corpus oracle are reused unchanged; the induced basis adds candidates only and holds no authority.
obs_inherited_system.downstream_work_to_delete_or_supersede: Any roadmap step that adds another hand-written mutation kind, or that raises a candidate budget to fix a bug whose edit is not expressible.
obs_inherited_system.fresh_reuse_plan: Recompute the ladder and re-run both bases from the receipt's commands; the corpus is public and the answer key is never needed.

obs_obs.analysis_steps_deleted_or_cached: Reused the learned inline skill, the reach scanner and the run-in-a-copy runner; no second action library, no new oracle, no model.
obs_obs.search_stop_decision: Stop at four independent samples (228 pairs); the per-sample staleness spread 45-58% already bounds the claim, and more samples buy precision, not a new fact.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The plan saves search but never carries authority; the postcondition check costs one parse and one name scan per application and removes the 71 silent corruptions by construction.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The same protocol applies to any state, including a GUI window: re-observe, re-prove the premise, act, re-read.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Plain replay is wrong 53.5% of the time and silently wrong 31.1%; a fingerprint alone still admits the 4 zero-drift stale cases; one plan per state is unbounded and still unproved; a model is prohibited producer cognition.

obs_solution.white_box_harvest_note: The canonical ladder is recorded in full; the WHITE_BOX_HARVEST step was considered and found empty. No donor model, weight or external artifact was harvested: the mechanism was induced from the corpus's own demonstration pairs and the tree's own repair primitive.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: The corpus's own published tests are the oracle; unit tests pin only the mechanism and the measurement's integrity. Independent reproduction remains open.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: On 268 real commits from five public repositories, 16.0 percent contain a sibling site at the loosest rung and 11.6 percent when the neighbourhood must match on both sides. Across 245 sibling pairs the demonstrated edit reproduced the developer's edit 181 times, but 103 of those were verbatim repeats; on the 142 pairs needing induction it was right 78 times (0.5493) and wrong 64. Determinacy fell from 53 percent at one changed line to 21 percent at five.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Routing instead of promising: decide from the target's own context whether memory applies (verbatim or clean binding), whether the edit invents a value the target does not determine, or whether there is no sibling at all -- and only let memory run in the first case, with the postcondition checked because a forced prediction cannot be told from a lucky one at run time.

route_frontier.incumbent_route: record the edit a learned action produced and replay that plan wherever the action is needed
route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Three routes were refused on this tree's own measurement: plain replay (53.5% of 228 real compositions stale, 31.1% silently corrupt), fingerprint-only invalidation (necessary, but 4 stale replays had zero drift), and one stored plan per state (unbounded, and every plan is still unproved on the next state). A model-based repair was refused as producer cognition.

recursive_obs.stop_condition: One merged change on this branch in which a legal step that falsifies an earlier verified fact is detected at the causal step, with controls showing no false invalidations and a lead measured against the symptom.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It needs no model and no new store: frames acquired last round already name the paths a step may touch, so the invalidation rule is a set intersection and a hash, and it localises the cause instead of the symptom.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It adds a dict of hashes and one rule, and it deletes the assumption that a verified fact persists. Nothing is trained and nothing is stored beyond the run.
